prBodyNotes: :warning: **PAIRING DOCTRINE**: nix-email's nixpkgs pin must move TOGETHER with SystemNix's flake.lock (same rev - see AGENTS.md conventions). Merge only in the same window as the SystemNix bump and re-run `nix flake check` in BOTH repos. If nixpkgs moves `services.stalwart` past 0.15.5, note it in README first (the module pin is 0.15.5; 0.16.x is module-incompatible).
